tldr: The Account Health page for WhatsApp Cloud API inboxes now shows phone, capacity, business account and webhook details. A scheduled job checks each number every 6 hours.
goal: Admins cannot see when a WhatsApp number loses quality or access.

story.heading: WhatsApp stores the phone number health
story.body: The service reads phone and business account data from the Graph API. It stores the result on the channel.

story.heading: Background jobs enqueue the health scheduler hourly
story.body: The hourly trigger now enqueues the health scheduler, which queues one sync per due WhatsApp channel.

story.heading: Account Health page shows four sections
story.body: The page shows phone, capacity, business account and webhook sections. It shows the coexistence badge only for coexistence numbers.

story.heading: Platform adds health columns to the channel
story.body: The channel_whatsapp table gets 3 columns and an index on the check time.

story.heading: Health sync job calls the health service
story.body: The job runs on the low queue and calls the health service for one channel.

story.heading: Channel stores the last health check
story.body: Each check writes the health JSON and the check time. The scheduler reads the check time to pick channels.

story.heading: WhatsApp health monitoring tracks each number
story.body: Scheduled checks and page requests both read Meta data. The Account Health page shows the latest result.

components.summary: Shows the Account Health page with phone, capacity, business account and webhook sections.
Runs an hourly trigger that enqueues the WhatsApp health scheduler.
Reads phone and business account health from Meta, stores it, and reports authorization errors.
Adds 3 health columns and an index to channel_whatsapp.

decisions.title: Store the last health result on the channel
decisions.why: The scheduler finds due channels with one query on the check time, without calling Meta.

decisions.title: Limit each scheduler run to a bulk size
decisions.why: Each run checks the oldest channels first, up to the bulk limit of external HTTP calls.
decisions.alternative: Check every due channel in one run

decisions.title: Pin health calls to Graph API v24 or later
decisions.why: The health fields need a newer API version than the global setting, until integrations move to the latest version.

decisions.title: Treat error code 190 as an authorization failure
decisions.why: Admins get a guide to refresh the connection, without Meta error codes.
decisions.alternative: Show the Meta error code and message

flows.title: Sync phone number health for one channel
Queue health syncs for due channels
Enqueue the health scheduler every hour
